name: Pylon
summary: Customer support platform for B2B companies.

flows.title: Reply to an issue
steps: Open the issue and use the message editor; make sure Reply is selected, not Note, so your message goes directly to the customer wherever they originally reached out.
Type your message in the rich text editor, which supports mentions and attachments, then click the send button to deliver it.

flows.title: Tag an issue
steps: Open the issue and find the tags field on the record.
Select one or more existing tag values to apply, or type a new value to create and apply a new tag on the spot.

flows.title: Change an issue's status
steps: Open the issue, then click on its status to choose a new one from the dropdown: New, On You, On Customer, On Hold, or Closed.
You can also drag the issue's card on the Kanban Board, or press the S key while the issue is open to change its status.

flows.title: Create a broadcast
steps: Go to the Broadcasts page and click Create.

Give the broadcast a title (only used to help you find it later, never shown to recipients), then choose to send it as a Channel broadcast to Slack or Teams, or as an Email broadcast, and write your message.
Select your audience by filtering on account or contact criteria, picking channels or contacts manually, or uploading a CSV.
Send a preview to check formatting, then choose Send now, Schedule for later, or Save draft.
